Network reached 288 facilities across 10 countries as of March 31, 2026.
Orbit Healthcare Services (Mauritius) Limited completed USD 200,000 investment in Orbit Health Care ETH PLC, making it a step-down subsidiary
Total doctor strength crossed 1,000 across the network in FY26.
Q1FY27: 18 greenfield facilities commissioned (16 surgical), taking the India network to 285 facilities across 14 states and 5 union territories.
Q1FY27: SSSG for the pre-FY23 cohort was 16.3%, with volume and value each contributing about 8%.
Q1FY27: 1,057 doctors, up 23% YoY; 100 added in the last four months, mostly for new centres.
Scheme of Amalgamation of Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited into Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited becomes effective November 1, 2026.

timeline.summary: Dr. Agarwal's Health Care announced that the NCLT Chennai Bench allowed the joint first motion application for the amalgamation of Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited.
2026-05-15: Dr. Agarwal's Health Care receives ₹15.08 Cr GST show cause notice for FY22 discrepancies
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹564.11 Cr (+22.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹39.71 Cr (+21.9% YoY).
Dr. Agarwal's Health Care reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,080 Cr and net profit of ₹168 Cr.
Dr. Agarwal's Health Care announced that its Mauritius subsidiary completed a USD 200,000 investment in Orbit Health Care ETH PLC, making it a step-down subsidiary.
Dr. Agarwal's Health Care held its Q4 and FY26 earnings call, reporting record annual revenue exceeding ₹2,000 Cr.
2026-06-01: Dr. Agarwal's Health Care announced NCLT-convened meeting of equity shareholders for the amalgamation of Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited on July 2, 2026.
2026-08-07: Dr. Agarwal's Health Care released the Q1FY27 earnings call transcript, reporting 26% revenue growth to ₹614 Cr and 18 new greenfield facilities.
Dr. Agarwal's Health Care announced the amalgamation of Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital to be effective November 1, 2026, with a record date of November 18, 2026.
